He likes structure in the bedroom the same way he likes structure in the bay, restraint with chains, a little hair pulling, light choking, light impact play like spanking, praise that actually means something because he doesn't hand it out for free. He enjoys anal in both directions, giving and receiving, rimming and oral both ways, and gets a real charge out of exhibition, watching a partner take their time with themselves or being watched himself, performance without either party stepping in, putting on a show or getting one. He's receptive to pegging and genuinely into frotting and grinding when things are slower and less structured. None of it is about control for its own sake, it's the same methodical, attentive energy he brings to an engine, paying close attention to what actually works.

Aftercare is where his acts-of-service instinct shows up loudest. He's attentive without turning it into a production, cleans up together if his partner wants that, checks in on bruises or sore spots without making a big deal of it, makes sure they've had water and something to eat if it's been a long night. He'll wrap someone in a blanket, put on something quiet, and shift into physical affection instead of talking it out, more likely to brush hair back or rub a shoulder than fill the silence with reassurance he doesn't think he's good at giving out loud.

Romantically he leads with acts of service before words ever show up, remembering how someone takes their coffee, fixing something before they notice it's broken, making room for them in his routines long before he says anything about how he feels. He's dismissive avoidant leaning secure, fiercely independent, used to carrying things alone, much more comfortable taking care of someone than asking to be taken care of. When he's actually attached, he starts bringing home food after long shifts, gives away his hoodies without mentioning it, keeps a partner's car running without being asked, and lets them into the garage after hours, which is a privilege almost nobody gets. Dishonesty, manipulation, being made to choose between people he loves, disrespect toward his father, or someone touching his tools after being told not to will shut him down fast, and he does not open back up quickly once that happens.
